DesignSystems.metaDescription: The design system behind magnusmagi.com — colors, typography, spacing, motion, and components.
DesignSystems.heading: The system behind the site
DesignSystems.subhead: A living spec of the tokens and primitives that hold magnusmagi.com together. Built in Tailwind v4 with CSS variables — light and dark side by side.
DesignSystems.intro: Everything on this site is built from a small set of tokens. Below they're laid bare so you can copy, fork, or just see how the pieces fit.

sections.colorsDesc: Six tokens drive the entire palette. Each maps to a CSS custom property and flips automatically with the OS color scheme.
sections.typographyDesc: Nunito for body, Geist Mono for metadata. Tracking is wide on uppercase mono, tight on display headings.
sections.spacingDesc: Tailwind's default 4px scale. Layouts breathe at 24/40/64. Sections stack with 80–120 vertical rhythm.
sections.radiusDesc: Soft on cards, sharp on chips. Buttons borrow the card radius.
sections.motionDesc: Subtle easing, short durations. All motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
sections.principle1Body: One typeface family, one accent, one rhythm. Limits make decisions easy and the surface coherent.
sections.principle2Body: Tight measure, generous leading, wide tracking on metadata. The page should be quiet.
sections.principle3Body: Light and dark are not skins — they share contrast ratios, accent intensity, and shadows. Both are first-class.
sections.principle4Body: Animation only where it carries meaning — a tap, a reveal, a state change. Never decorative.

examples.subhead: Subhead — the tagline that follows a heading.
examples.body: Body copy — used for paragraphs, prose, and long reads.
examples.cardBody: Cards group related content with a single border and generous padding. Hover lifts the accent.

Play.metaDescription: A small collection of mono-typography mini-games — Mägi Bird and 2048.
Play.heading: Mini-games
Play.subhead: A short distraction. Mono-typography, no ads, no tracking. Best scores are saved to this browser.

notes.privacy: No tracking. No ads. Best scores live in your browser only.
notes.credits: Inspired by 2048 by Gabriele Cirulli (MIT), Snake from the 1970s arcade era, and the tap-to-flap arcade tradition. Country flag images served by flagcdn.com (free for any use). Original implementation, MIT licensed.

magibird.cardDescription: Tap to flap, dodge the pipes. Reaction-based action.
magibird.metaDescription: Mägi Bird — a mono-typography flap-and-dodge mini-game.
magibird.heading: Mägi Bird
magibird.subhead: Tap, click, or press space to flap. Best score is saved to this browser.
magibird.pressToStart: Press space or tap to start
magibird.controlsHint: Space · Click · Tap · R to restart

g2049.cardDescription: Slide tiles, combine numbers, double your way up. Pure logic.
g2049.metaDescription: A mono-typography number-merge puzzle — slide tiles, combine pairs, double your way up.
g2049.subhead: Slide tiles with arrows, WASD, or swipe. Combine matching numbers and double your way up. Best score is saved to this browser.
g2049.controlsHint: Arrows · WASD · Swipe · R to restart

snake.cardDescription: Eat. Grow. Don't bite yourself. The classic, mono.
snake.metaDescription: A mono-typography Snake — eat the dots, grow the line, avoid yourself.
snake.heading: Snake
snake.subhead: Steer with arrows, WASD, or swipe. Eat the dot to grow. Speed creeps up with each bite. Best score is saved to this browser.
snake.pressToStart: Press an arrow or swipe to start
snake.controlsHint: Arrows · WASD · Swipe · R to restart

mines.cardDescription: Reveal cells, flag mines, deduce your way through. Pure logic.
mines.metaDescription: A mono-typography minesweeper — reveal safe cells, flag the mines, beat your best time.
mines.heading: Mägi Mines
mines.subhead: Tap to reveal. Long-press or right-click to flag. Use arrow keys + Space to play with keyboard. The first click is always safe. Best time per difficulty is saved to this browser.
mines.controlsHint: Tap / Space reveal · Long-press / right-click / F flag · Arrows navigate · R restart

kolmik.cardDescription: Three in a row. You are X, the machine is O. Easy or hard.
kolmik.metaDescription: A mono-typography three-in-a-row — outplay the machine, or try to draw against it on hard.
kolmik.heading: Kolmik
kolmik.subhead: Three in a row. You play X, the machine plays O. Easy plays randomly. Hard plays perfectly — at best you draw. Wins, draws, and losses are saved to this browser per difficulty.
kolmik.controlsHint: Tap / click · Arrows + Space · R restart

riigid.cardDescription: Guess the country from its flag. Ten rounds, easy or hard.
riigid.metaDescription: A mono-typography flag quiz — guess the country from its flag across ten rounds.
riigid.heading: Riigid
riigid.subhead: Guess the country from its flag. Ten rounds, four options each. Easy covers about fifty well-known countries; hard covers every UN member state. Best score per difficulty is saved to this browser. Flags served by flagcdn.com.
riigid.controlsHint: Tap an option · 10 rounds per game
